args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Emma Johnson's Hawaii Trip: June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- 1-2 nicer outfits for restaurants/luaus
- Lightweight rain jacket
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip-flops
- Water shoes for snorkeling
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Cooler for beach days

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots/shoes (for Diamond Head)
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts (sun protection)
- Daypack/backpack
- Water bottle/hydration system
- Trail snacks

PERSONAL CARE:
- Toiletries (shampoo, conditioner, etc.)
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Medications
- Insect repellent
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (if required)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/e-reader for relaxation
- Travel pillow
- Earplugs
- Small first aid kit
- Reusable shopping bags
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Pearl Harbor: Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- Luau: Hawaiian shirt/dress or aloha attire
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Kayaking: Quick-dry clothing, waterproof bag for valuables

REMEMBER:
- Check weather forecast before finalizing packing
- Leave some space in luggage for souvenirs
- Pack liquids in TSA-approved containers if carrying on
